create_omp_reconstruct: create a sparse signal reconstruction using OrthogonalMatchingPursuit with a fixed number of non-zero coefficients
create_omp_cv_reconstruct: create a sparse signal reconstruction using OrthogonalMatchingPursuitCV to auto-select the number of non-zero coefficients via cross-validation
create_make_sparse_coded_signal: create a sparse coded signal with make_sparse_coded_signal for generating synthetic sparse data
test_omp_fit: test the OrthogonalMatchingPursuit fit method on noise-free and noisy measurements
review_omp_coefs: review the OrthogonalMatchingPursuit coef_ attribute to inspect recovered non-zero coefficients
